Several days (many hours: 300 kills, five bosses and lots of travelling)

{npc:Tarun} wants to know where the Asuri go when they vanish from the {wiki:Asura Palace|Asura Palace}. You defeat three asuri princesses, put together the three parts of the {item:Asuri Talisman} and discover the island of {wiki:Marapur|Marapur}, where you help the nagas of the coast and the mountain: you heal the beavers, save the sage Timira, repair the observatory, organise the wedding of {npc:Candra} and {npc:Nihaka} and recover the stolen eggs. You gain access to Marapur, the {item:Colourful Water Lily} ({wiki:Giant Beaver (Mount)|Giant Beaver} mount), the {item:Lilypad Backpack}, the {item:Naga Nest} and the achievement **Wedding Planner**.
Tarun has noticed that the Asuri seem to visit a distant place from time to time. Will you help him investigate?
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 150** (there are five bosses and strong creatures in the Asura Palace and in Marapur).
A diving helmet: {item:Helmet of the Deep} or {item:Depth Galea} (for the Marapur vortices).
to repair the observatory's water wheel
a few, to carve an ice flower
from {creature:The Flaming Orchid} (or bought on the Market)
from {creature:The Moonlight Aster} (or bought on the Market)
only from {creature:The Winter Bloom} — the Market one does NOT work
to climb back up from the hidden rooms of the Asura Palace and from the Edron chamber
{spell:Levitate} to climb the Kha'zeel Mountains (portal to Marapur)

Part 1 (*Of Feathers and Flowers*): with the {item:Asuri Talisman}, the portal at the top of the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains} (floor +5) takes you to Marapur.
*Coastal Concerns* part: {npc:Nilavarna} gives you the {item:Colourful Water Lily}, with which you can tame a Giant Beaver.

The order of the missions matters. This guide follows the order that works: **1)** Of Feathers and Flowers → **2)** Coastal Concerns → **3)** Observatory (Mountainous Matters) → **4)** Star-Crossed Lovers → **5)** Stolen eggs (end of Mountainous Matters).

Only the {item:Swan Feather (Asura)} from {creature:The Winter Bloom} works to find the Golden Hand. The {item:Flamingo Feather} and the {item:Peacock Feather} can be bought on the Market or borrowed: one of each is enough for any number of players.
Carry the three feathers **in your backpack** when you go to the treasure chambers, otherwise the locations don't appear or open.
Constellations can only be registered at **night** ({wiki:Night|Tibian time}). Plan that part ahead.
Gather the cheap items right at the start: {item:Hammer}, {item:Ice Cube|Ice Cubes}, {item:Honeycomb}, {item:Mango} and {item:Juice Squeezer}.

It starts in Tiquanda and takes place in the {wiki:Asura Palace|Asura Palace}. You need to defeat three asuri princesses, find three treasure chambers and assemble the {item:Asuri Talisman} to open the portal to Marapur.

{npc:Tarun} is in Tiquanda, next to the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass|Kha'zeel Pass}, near the pass's wooden bridge. The simplest way is from **Ankrahmun**: leave the city to the **west** and climb the mountains ({creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}), cross the bridge up there (there is a {creature:Nomad} and a few {creature:Bandit|Bandits}) and go down until you reach a staircase that takes you to the jungle side. You can also walk from **Port Hope**, east through the Tiquanda jungle.
Route from Ankrahmun through the Kha'zeel Pass (1)
Route from Ankrahmun through the Kha'zeel Pass (2)
Route from Ankrahmun through the Kha'zeel Pass (3)
To go back, take the same way in reverse to Ankrahmun, or head west through the jungle to Port Hope (the southern side is the easiest and safest).
Go to the north-east area of **Tiquanda** and talk to {npc:Tarun}. Say {key:hi}, {key:asuri} and accept with {key:yes}. He thinks the Asuri use something in the palace to travel to a distant place.

From {npc:Tarun}, walk **north** to the {wiki:Asura Palace|Asura Palace}. The creatures that open the princesses' rooms are in hidden rooms: you get there by falling through cracks in the floor ({item:Some Cracks (Hole)}) or through the {item:Pitfall} in the grass patch, and after each one you climb back up.
Bring a {item:Rope} to climb back up from the hidden rooms. The {wiki:Asura Palace Quest|Asura Palace Quest} guide explains the fastest order to visit them.

The three princesses are behind sealed doors. To open {creature:The Flaming Orchid}'s room, kill **2** {creature:Greater Fire Elemental|Greater Fire Elementals} and **3** {creature:Cave Hydra|Cave Hydras} in the palace, at the marked locations.
Enter the room and kill {creature:The Flaming Orchid}. She drops the {item:Flamingo Feather}.
You can skip this boss if you buy the Flamingo Feather on the Market or if someone lends it to you.
Kill **2** {creature:Vicious Lich|Vicious Liches} and **2** {creature:Vile Destroyer|Vile Destroyers} at the marked locations to open {creature:The Moonlight Aster}'s room.
Enter and kill {creature:The Moonlight Aster}. She drops the {item:Peacock Feather}.
You can also buy the Peacock Feather on the Market.
Kill **2** {creature:Greater Energy Elemental|Greater Energy Elementals} and **1** {creature:Solitary Frost Dragon} at the marked locations to open {creature:The Winter Bloom}'s room.
Enter and kill {creature:The Winter Bloom}. She drops the right {item:Swan Feather (Asura)|Swan Feather}.
The Swan Feather sold on the Market is **not** the right one for the Golden Hand's location. You really have to loot this feather from The Winter Bloom (or borrow it from someone who has it).
With the three feathers, go up in the palace to this spot and use the {item:Ornate Case} to receive a {item:Parchment}.
Go down to the prisoner {npc:Gilmak Copperbeard} and ask him about the nagas: {key:hi}, {key:naga}. He tells you where to look for the three treasure chambers and which feather to bring to each.
Ankrahmun — next to a dragon skeleton in the tar seas of the southern Darama desert
Edron — north of the Stonehome cemetery

Climb out of the hidden rooms and go down the tower to the ground floor; leave through the palace entrance and head back **south** to {npc:Tarun}. From there follow the Kha'zeel Pass east to **Ankrahmun** (the closest to the first treasure chamber) or go back through the jungle to Port Hope.

With the **three feathers in your backpack**, go to the chamber near **Ankrahmun**: from the city walk to the tar seas in the south of the Darama desert and stand next to the dragon skeleton with the {item:Flamingo Feather}. Pick up the {item:Silver Hand} and walk back the same way.
If you don't have the three feathers in your inventory (in your backpack), the location doesn't appear or open.

Go to the island of {wiki:Folda|Folda}: in **Carlin**, talk to the ferryman {npc:Nielson}, north-west of the city, and say {key:hi}, {key:folda} and {key:yes} (20 gp). From the Folda dock go to the area **east of the mountains** with the {item:Swan Feather (Asura)|Swan Feather} and pick up the {item:Golden Hand} at this spot. To go back, return to the dock and talk to {npc:Svenson}: the trip back to the mainland is free.

In **Edron**, before the Bronze Hand, first fetch the handwritten message at this spot (floor -3). The search starts on the surface, **north of the Stonehome cemetery** (a village north-east of Edron), with the {item:Peacock Feather} and the three feathers in your backpack: that is where the entrance appears and opens in the ground.
Bring a {item:Rope}: to leave, climb back up the same way to the surface next to Stonehome and walk back to Edron.
After the message, go to this spot and pick up the {item:Bronze Hand}.
Use the three hands on each other until you get the complete {item:Asuri Talisman}.
Go to the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains|Kha'zeel Mountains}, between Tiquanda and Ankrahmun, and step into the portal at the top of the mountain (floor +5). You are teleported to {wiki:Marapur|Marapur}.

Get {spell:Levitate} ready: in the Kha'zeel Mountains many of the paths to the upper floors can only be done with Levitate.
To leave Marapur, use {npc:Ziyad}'s magic carpet in Moonfall (say {key:hi} and ask him about destinations; Premium only).
The coastal nagas (Silvertides) will only help you if you prove your goodwill. This mission has three parts: curing the beavers, hunting Foam Stalkers and saving Timira.

In Marapur, go **west** of the Silvertides depot and talk to {npc:Dhira}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He needs a cure for the sick giant beavers, made with {item:Moon Mint} and {item:Coral Branch}.
Go to the Fading Isles and pick a {item:Moon Mint} from a {item:Moon Mint (Immobile)|Moon Mint} plant. The nearest one is here.
Put on the diving helmet and dive into the {wiki:Great Pearl Fan Reef|Great Pearl Fan Reef}. Kill {creature:Foam Stalker|Foam Stalkers} until one drops a {item:Coral Branch}.
Great Pearl Fan Reef (beneath the island)

The reef is beneath the main island of Marapur. Keep the diving helmet on while you are there and, to leave, go back to the area where you fell through the vortex and climb back to the surface the same way.
Go to the building just **south** of the Silvertides depot (the laboratory). Use the {item:Coral Branch} on the {item:Mortar} on a table on the **west** side of the room to get {item:Coral Powder}.
Go to the **east** side of the room and use the {item:Moon Mint} and the {item:Coral Powder} on the {item:Refiner of Magic}. You receive the {item:Cure for Sick Beavers}.

Go a little **north** of Dhira and talk to {npc:Nilavarna}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He asks you to kill **300** {creature:Foam Stalker|Foam Stalkers} and {creature:Two-Headed Turtle|Two-Headed Turtles} (they count together).

Go to the island west of the Stardance Mountains with the {item:Helmet of the Deep} or {item:Depth Galea} on and jump into the vortex to the {wiki:Great Pearl Fan Reef|Great Pearl Fan Reef}. Kill 300 {creature:Foam Stalker|Foam Stalkers} and {creature:Two-Headed Turtle|Two-Headed Turtles}. At the end, leave like the first time: go back to the vortex area and climb up the same way.
Go back to {npc:Nilavarna}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. Now he asks you to save **Timira**, a wise naga cursed by the Asuri who hid in a cave beneath the Emerald Gardens.
Go to the north-east sub-area of the **Emerald Gardens** and enter the small portal inside a house. The fight is for **up to 5 players** and you have **10 minutes** to defeat Timira.
You only have 10 minutes for the three phases. Don't waste time.

Pick up an empty bucket (Empty Bucket) from the floor. Wait until the water starts to **glow** and, **next to the water**, use the bucket on it to get a {item:Bucket Full of Sparkles}. Then use that bucket on the **Shattered Water** on the **east** wall of the room. Repeat: you need **4 buckets per player** in the room (it doesn't matter who uses them).
If you end up with a {item:Bucket Full of Water} by mistake, pour the water on the floor to reuse the bucket.
{creature:Corrupt Naga|Corrupt Nagas} and {creature:Rogue Naga|Rogue Nagas} respawn quickly in the room. Block them, walk around them or kill them while you do the mechanic.
When an energy effect appears across the room, use the **Trapped Water** to open the portal. Open the **Ornamented Chest** next to the portal (extra reward) and enter the portal to the **south**.

Use the **Corrupted Trapped Water** until it is clean and becomes Trapped Water. You can only use it **once every 30 seconds**, so deal with the nagas while you wait. Then use the Trapped Water to open the portal, open the chest to the **north** and move on to the final room.
You lose health and mana every time you successfully use the Corrupted Trapped Water.

There are no mechanics here: kill {creature:Timira the Many-Headed}. You can trap her in a corner to the **north-west** of the room to make it easier. Afterwards you can talk to {npc:Timira} ({key:hi}, {key:attacked}, {key:trapped}): she thanks you for freeing her from the curse.

The wiki doesn't describe the exit from Timira's cave: at the end of the fight (or of the 10 minutes) look for the exit from the final room or go back through the portals to the Emerald Gardens house you entered through.
Go back to {npc:Nilavarna} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}. You receive the {item:Colourful Water Lily}, used to tame a {wiki:Giant Beaver (Mount)|Giant Beaver}.
The mountain nagas (Moonfall) also need help. Do the observatory part now: it is required for the wedding mission.
From the Moonfall depot head **south-east** and climb a large building to the top floor, where {npc:Udu} is. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.

Go down in the same building until you find a water wheel. In that room go **north** and use the lever to slow it down. Then use the {item:Hammer} on the water wheel to repair it (the Quest Log is updated).
Go back to {npc:Udu}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. The telescope lens is missing; a moa stole it and hid it in a nest.
Go to the west part of the Stardance Mountains, near prince {npc:Nihaka}, and a little to the **south** use the {item:Jungle Moa Nest} to find the {item:Glass Lens}.
There are {creature:Jungle Moa|Jungle Moas} and {creature:Parder|Parders} in the mountains.

Take the lens to {npc:Udu}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. She gives you a {item:Celestial Chart} and asks you to register three constellations: the Turtle ({key:Turtle}), the Southern Crab ({key:Crab}) and the Smaller Rose ({key:Rose}).
At **night**, go to the top of the mountains of the Murmuring Wilderness and use the {item:Celestial Chart} at this spot.
At **night**, go to the big statue at the Sparkling Lagoon and use the {item:Celestial Chart} at this spot.
At **night**, climb the Moonfall watchtower and use the {item:Celestial Chart} at this spot.

Only start this mission after you have finished Coastal Concerns and Udu's observatory, otherwise you can't progress. Candra (coast naga) and Nihaka (mountain naga) want to marry and need their parents' approval.
In the coastal palace go up the stairs **twice** and talk to {npc:Candra}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You have to talk to her **first**. She sends you to the shaman {npc:Tarisu}.

Go to the temple **south-east** of Silvertides and talk to {npc:Tarisu}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. If you hadn't cured the beavers yet, he would send you to Dhira first. He also tells you to talk to the shaman {npc:Vrisaki}.

Go to the Moonfall temple, just **north** of the depot, going up 3 flights of ramps, and talk to {npc:Vrisaki}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. If you hadn't helped Udu yet, she would send you to the observatory first.
After helping Dhira and Udu, talk to Vrisaki and Tarisu again. Depending on the order in which you did the missions, you may need to say {key:mission} twice to each of them.

Talk to {npc:Tarisu} and {npc:Vrisaki} again ({key:mission}). Each shaman asks for two good omens to prove the wedding is not cursed. You can ask {key:water}, {key:pearl}, {key:flower} and {key:damselfly} for more clues.
{item:Blessed Water} (water from the graveyard island lake)
Go up the ramp on the **east** side of the east ramp at this spot. Follow the path **south-east** until you find a {item:Pile of Dry Wood}. Use it to get a {item:Splint}.
Ramp (way to the Pile of Dry Wood)
Go back **north**, turn **left** onto the other path of this passage and follow it **south** to a fireplace. Use the {item:Splint} on the fireplace to get a {item:Burning Splint}.

Go to the small island in the far **north-east** of Marapur, where there is a frozen lake. Use the {item:Burning Splint} on the lake to melt the water and then use the water to receive a flask with {item:Blessed Water}.
Go to the **east** side of Marapur and dive into the vortex with the diving helmet on. Use the {item:Large Seashell (Moonshine)|Large Seashell} to pick up the {item:Moonshine Pearl}.
If you are with other players, the pearl takes 1 minute to respawn for the next one.

Tarisu says the pearl is in the {wiki:Temple of the Moon Goddess|Temple of the Moon Goddess}: there is a {item:Large Seashell (Shimmering)} there with a {item:Shimmering Pearl}, which is **not** the right pearl. You can only pick it up during this mission; if you want it, pick it up **before** the real pearl.
Go to the mountain and talk to {npc:Nihaka}: {key:hi}, {key:damselfly}. You receive an empty {item:Butterfly Conservation Kit (Empty)|Butterfly Conservation Kit}.
Go to the big naga statue between Silvertides and Moonfall. You find out that someone killed all the damselflies.
Go back to {npc:Nihaka}: {key:hi}, {key:damselfly}. He suggests attracting more damselflies with mango and honey juice.
Use the {item:Juice Squeezer} on a {item:Mango} to get a {item:Flask of Mango Juice}. Then use the flask on a {item:Honeycomb} to get a {item:Flask of Mango Honey Juice}.

Go back to the statue and use the {item:Flask of Mango Honey Juice} on the lake water so that {creature:Emerald Damselfly|Emerald Damselflies} appear. Use the kit on a **live** damselfly to catch it. You end up with the {item:Butterfly Conservation Kit (Damselfly)|Butterfly Conservation Kit} holding the damselfly.
Kill the {creature:Venerable Foam Stalker}, a special Foam Stalker found at this spot. It **always** drops a {item:Foam Stalker Spume}.
Go to the mountain of the Murmuring Wilderness. Use the {item:Foam Stalker Spume} on the ground next to a Burnt Coral Vow Flower and pick up the {item:Coral Vow Flower}.
Take the damselfly and the flower to {npc:Nihaka}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}.

Take the pearl and the holy water to {npc:Candra}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. She found out that her friend **Kusuma** is actually an asura in disguise who sabotaged the wedding, and asks you to eliminate her.
Go to the west mountain. Step on the **Energy Vein** symbol next to the wall: you are teleported to the room just **south** of that tile. Kill {creature:Kusuma}.
The wiki doesn't describe the exit from the room: after opening the chest, look for the way back to the Energy Vein you came in through.
After defeating her, open the chest and take the {item:Gemmed Lotus Brooch}. **Keep it**: you need it to find the stolen eggs.
Go back to {npc:Nihaka} or {npc:Candra} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}. You receive the {item:Lilypad Backpack} and the achievement **Wedding Planner**.
For this part you must have helped Udu and completed Star-Crossed Lovers (you need the Canary Feather and the Gemmed Lotus Brooch).
Go to the mountain and talk to the maharani {npc:Saraki}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. The Asuri stole naga eggs; she tells you to talk to {npc:Kaumudi}.
Talk to {npc:Kaumudi}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. She doesn't know where the eggs are and sends you to the shaman {npc:Vrisaki}.
Kaumudi gives you no useful information: if you want, you can go straight to Vrisaki.
Go to the top of the mountain and ask {npc:Vrisaki} about the eggs: {key:hi}, {key:naga eggs} (or {key:egg}). She asks for three objects to protect the spirits and gives you her {item:Icicle Chisel}.
Kill {creature:Parder|Parders} until you get a {item:Parder Fur}.
Go to {npc:Candra} and pick up the {item:Canary Feather} from the bird cage next to her (only works after you complete Star-Crossed Lovers).
Use the {item:Icicle Chisel} on the {item:Ice Cube|Ice Cubes} to carve an ice flower. Any of them will do: {item:Pretty Ice Flower}, {item:Beautiful Ice Flowers} or {item:Marvelous Ice Flowers}.
Use the objects on the Stony Face
Go back to {npc:Vrisaki} and use the three objects (Parder Fur, Canary Feather and the ice flower) on the {item:Stony Face} near her.
Talk to {npc:Vrisaki} again: {key:hi}, {key:naga eggs}. She has a vision: the eggs are in a secret room at the bottom of the sunken Moon Goddess temple.

Take the {item:Gemmed Lotus Brooch} to the **second floor** of the sunken temple ({wiki:Temple of the Moon Goddess|Temple of the Moon Goddess}, beneath the main island of Marapur; wear the diving helmet). Use the brooch on the indicated wall and then use the wall to enter the room. Once you have the eggs, leave the temple the same way you came in.
Temple of the Moon Goddess (first floor)
The sunken temple is occupied by hostile nagas. Go prepared.
Use the big stone to the **north** of the room to find the hidden {item:Bag with Naga Eggs}.
Take the eggs to {npc:Kaumudi}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. One of the nests hatched with you around and the hatchlings think you are their mother. You receive the {item:Naga Nest}.

Go back to {npc:Saraki}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. She asks for help with Timira. Since you already saved her in Coastal Concerns, you don't have to fight again: say {key:mission} **one more time** to complete the quest.
If you hadn't defeated Timira yet, you would have to do the fight described in section 2 before going back to Saraki.
To return to the mainland, go to the magic carpet in **Moonfall** and talk to {npc:Ziyad}: say {key:hi} and ask him about the destinations (magic carpets are for Premium players only).
The quest is also known as the **Marapur Quest**.
With the {item:Colourful Water Lily} you can tame a {wiki:Giant Beaver (Mount)|Giant Beaver} (mount).
Kusuma is one of the quest's Archfoe bosses, along with The Moonlight Aster, The Winter Bloom, The Flaming Orchid and Timira the Many-Headed.
